blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Bagong Alyansang Makabayan (Bayan) President Renato Reyes has condemned the series of apprehensions against protesters on Sunday, describing it as the “biggest mass arrest in a single day” under the administration of Pres. Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. Various groups earlier this Sunday held protests to oppose the anticipated visit of United States President Donald Trump for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and the Pax Silica initiative, which they said will displace indigenous communities and farmers in Central Luzon.
